title: ノーコメント
text: “So it’s you. With those rabbit features, I suppose you could almost pass for a relative of that usaunny.”
“What do you want with me!? I don’t know anyone called an usaunny. If you go looking, you’ll find plenty of rabbit demi-humans and beastmen out there.”

“Is that so. Well, since we’ve met again, I thought it might be good to have a talk here, just in case. As you said, this country truly is terrible, and now I understand what the truth is. I owe you my thanks for the warning.”
“Then why are you restraining me!?”
“Because you ran. You didn’t need to run, did you? Unfortunately, I’ve come to no longer understand this thing you call justice, but I have no intention of denying it either.”
“Is that your roundabout way of trying to apologize to me?”
“Think whatever you like.”
“You’ve become such a troublesome person!”
Rabbit Guy and Itsuki were going back and forth like some kind of comedy skit, I say.
“……Actually, may I just shoot him as he is? Thinking about that usaunny is making me furious.”
“Stop that! I’ll dodge with everything I’ve got! I’ll have you know I’ve been trained!”
“Hey now, Itsuki, I’d rather you not go being violent with our Theo.”
“I understand that, but for some reason just seeing a rabbit stirs up murderous intent in me.”
“You know, there are plenty of rabbit-type beastmen over in Siltvelt too, right?”
Father let out a deep sigh at Itsuki’s attitude, scratching his head.
“How should I put it… maybe because the one who framed Itsuki was a beastman usaunny, he just can’t fully bring himself to side with demi-humans and beastmen?”
“No, that’s… I can’t quite put my current feelings into words, so I’ll just say no comment.”
“Anyway, Itsuki, weren’t you going to explain everything that’s happened so far to Ren, me, and Motoyasu-kun?”
“That’s right. Did you understand it all, Ren-san?”
“Ah, yeah… I guess I was just, you know, lucky.”

Ren showed intense sympathy for the wretched state Itsuki was in, I say. Well, in Ren’s case, his companions had properly believed in him, and thanks to Rafuemon acting as his body double, indeed. Even if his companions had reacted the same way as Itsuki’s Smoked Meat lot, Kuro-chan had been with him, so he surely would have been saved. Poor Itsuki — without Fleon-chan around, a man ends up this miserable, I say. Even I hadn’t expected Itsuki’s companions to turn on him so instantaneously, I say. I’d figured they’d at most keep things hidden from everyone else and carry on quietly, so this was unexpected, indeed. Those fellows were the type who flocked to Itsuki’s power, after all. That they’d let that go was simply astonishing — bigger fools than I’d expected, indeed. After all, Itsuki was the Perfect Hidden Justice who loved to operate under a false identity, I say. I’d thought it suited him perfectly — being persecuted in Melromarc in his riska form while secretly operating as Bow Hero, that seemed like a perfect fit, I say.
“Well… in Ren’s case, it’s fine since Rafuemon-chan is around too.”
“There’s plenty of problem!”
Ren yapped out his protest, but Luna-chan gazed at him as though she found his attitude endearing, I say.
“Who is this Rafuemon?”
“Did someone call?”
That guy shows up the moment you call his name, I say! To appear here of all places… does he intend to tell Itsuki and Ren who the usaunny is, or something like that?
“Nobody called you. Don’t come out.”
Ren answered with mounting hostility toward Rafuemon, I say.
“Being told that only makes it all the more necessary for me to appear. Hm? Is that Justice standing there?”
“Did you just call me ‘Justice’ of all things? What is that supposed to mean!?”
At Rafuemon’s remark, Itsuki readied his bow as if bracing for a fight, I say.
“Should I say it differently, then? Bow Hero. Or perhaps I should call you riska instead? Justice.”
“How did you know just from a single glance at me?”
“This thing is some bizarre creature claiming to be from the future, same as Motoyasu! He knows all sorts of things but keeps dodging every question!”
Ren seized the chance to lay into Rafuemon, I say. Good, keep at it, indeed.

“The Spear Hero isn’t the only messenger from the future. It just so happens there’s another one here too. Being accused of dodging questions wounds me, Azott. Coming from the likes of you, who rush into folly despite having knowledge, that argument carries no weight, does it?”
“Who cares! You knew the culprit was that usaunny guy, didn’t you!”
“Of course I did. But I’m not so uncouth as to simply hand it over.”
“Do you know where the usaunny is!? Tell me!”
Itsuki lunged at Rafuemon as though threatening him, I say. Rafuemon shrugged the threat off without a care, I say.
“Justice, the whereabouts of the one who turned you into a riska is—……”
“Stop calling me that! Justice is such a stupid word.”
“Ho… an interesting response, Justice.”
“I’m telling you to stop!”
“Itsuki, no matter how many times you tell him, he won’t correct himself.”
“Precisely, Justice. Understand now, Justice?”
“Rafuemon-chan, you just want to say ‘Justice’ at this point, don’t you……”
“Then I’ll just have to silence you physically. I won’t show any mercy right now.”
“Heh… go ahead and try, if you think you can, Justice.”
Rafuemon calmly pulled out his hammer, provoking him, I say.
“Hah!”

Itsuki loosed an arrow without hesitation, but Rafuemon swiftly dodged, flicked the arrow upward, and batted it back at Itsuki with a yawn. Itsuki nimbly dodged the returning arrow, but immediately after, Rafuemon circled around behind him and went pico! smacking him with the hammer turned squeaky mallet, I say.
“Wha—”
“Fube!? Why me too!?”
Rabbit Guy went down as collateral damage, indeed.
“At the very least, unless you properly practice your enhancement methods, you won’t even land a hit, you know?”
“Hah!”
And with that, Ren slashed at Rafuemon from the side with his sword, but with a poof! he dissolved into smoke and dodged it.
“Damn it! He’s dodging way too skillfully!”
“It seems Justice has grown quite the delinquent. Things have turned rather interesting. If I dare answer, a version of you this hardened doesn’t exist in either my data or the Spear Hero’s.”
Oh? Rafuemon dodged the question about the usaunny’s identity, indeed. He was putting into practice his belief that telling would be no fun, I say.
“Are you saying this is a future you don’t know?”
“On this one point, that’s correct. Now then, ask me again. Where is the usaunny.”
“Tell me! Where is that damn rabbit!?”
“Hey, you idiot!”
Ren tried to stop him, but Itsuki asked Rafuemon anyway, I say. Incidentally, Father kept glancing at me from time to time.
“Justice, as for where the usaunny who turned you into a riska is—……”
Ren had completely given up, while Itsuki looked endlessly irritated, I say.
“Where is the usaunny?”
“The whereabouts of the one who turned Justice into a riska is…………………………… not something I’ll tell you, chan!”
With a boof! Itsuki reflexively loosed an arrow, but Rafuemon dissolved into smoke and dodged the shot.
“See? This guy spouts suggestive nonsense but never actually says anything, and only ever does unnecessary things. Relying on him is a complete waste of time.”
“To be this infuriating… Naofumi-san! Why do you keep him around!?”
“I wouldn’t say I keep him around… apparently the reason he keeps looping back is to stop Motoyasu-kun from leaping at Filo-chan.”
“He’s an extremely infuriating enemy, I say!”
“Is that so. Though my heart aches, someone like him is of no concern to me.”
“It’s not fine!”
“Even so, the one who made him is future Ren, I say.”
At my remark, Itsuki glared at Ren, I say.
“Future Ren-san seems to have quite the twisted personality.”
“There’s no way I’d ever make something like that! He kept claiming it’s a parallel world so there’s no connection or whatever!”
“Already prepared countermeasures against changes to the future? What a pest of a creature.”
“Waah… Itsuki, that’s quite foul-mouthed.”
It came out sounding like something Rival would say, but my, what a wild Itsuki, indeed.

“Well, um… setting aside the matter of the culprit for now. Itsuki, what direction are you planning to move in from here? If you want to go to Siltvelt, I can take you there. I’ve got connections, so I could arrange for you to operate as a hero affiliated with Siltvelt, if you like.”
Father asked Itsuki what he wanted to do.
